authorship: Independently authored expectations frozen before the explanation-contract implementation; no production closure or renderer was used to calculate these expectations.
scope: Exact canonical ground-source entailment under nabt.verified-ground-reading.v1. These are public engineering acceptance controls, not blind Arabic coverage, source authenticity, world truth, action authority, or complete natural-language reading enumeration.

expectation_notation.clause_indices: Zero-based positions in exact source order; independent of filtered clean-theory indices.
expectation_notation.full_and_clean: The four booleans are relative to the exact query polarity, with explicit negation treated separately.
expectation_notation.contested_atoms: Both signed atoms must remain visible when both are derivable in the full closure.
expectation_notation.blocked_clauses: All source clauses excluded from the clean theory because their fact, head, or body mentions a contested signed atom.
expectation_notation.missing_premises: Local antecedents absent from the complete full closure. These are diagnostic conditions, not claims that adding them is a unique or minimal repair.

acceptance_boundaries.expected: Exact source/query/id/revision/scope mismatch must reject; the answer's own binding is never authority.
Deleting a displayed required premise, proof edge, contested atom, or excluded clause must make replay reject the whole answer.
Changed status, world-truth flag, action-authorization claim, or source-authenticity claim must reject; faithful source entailment alone grants none of these authorities.
Unavailable native checker produces CHECKER_UNAVAILABLE, no successful explanation bundle and no UNKNOWN or DEFER semantic substitute.
The explanation contract identifies an installed version; altered version, source/query/checker digest, or stale source revision rejects replay. Valid byte-identical replay succeeds.
The new explanation describes this canonical finite reading only; it cannot claim completeness of Arabic interpretations or collapse the existing ReadingEnumeration obligations.

preservation: This matrix is a new versioned artifact. Existing evidence/explainable_pilot cases, goals, first results, and all other historical gold remain unchanged.
